lines: The veil of night fell on Maesaki City.
Just as minor parties began throughout the town, dwellers of the underworld were taking each other's lives.
「Kageomi-sama, he has taken refuge in the back room.」
「He'll be on the brink now, right?」
Hearing the report from the assassination squad he led, Kageomi let a faint sneer show on his lips.
Almost an hour had passed since serial killer Saitou Hanjirou took refuge in this ruined building.
Kageomi had commanded his squad to slowly drive him into a place where there was no escape.
And now, at last, all that remained was the innermost room.
Saitou had not tried to fight much since entering this place.
He had just dedicated himself to running away.
However, the stomach wound that Kageomi had inflicted earlier was sure to be depleting his strength.
If they continued to besiege him like this, he would eventually drop dead from massive blood loss, but Kageomi was going to make sure to finish him off.
「Don't let your guards down. That guy's ninja arts are still a mystery.」
On Kageomi's signal, the assassination squad stormed the back room.
On the contrary, there was no sign of Saitou, who had escaped into there.
「What's the meaning of this?! Did he disappear again?」
『I did not take refuge. I lured you here.』
Saitou's voice was audible from somewhere.
（Keh, is he trying to get back at me for before?）
『I wonder about that. You ran away from my hand grenades.』
『Which means that you are not completely invincible. That you're not immortal.』
He was speaking in an awfully confident manner, not giving the slightest impression of any pain in his stomach.
（Bastard. Did he see through the secret of my ninja art? No, there's no way.）
（His strategy is to use that confusing chitchat to trick his opponent into blabbing. Like I'm gonna fall for that!）
Kageomi didn't know how, but there was no doubt that Saitou was hiding in this room.
The fact that Saitou had gone out of his way to address him was because he was cornered.
（In which case, I'll simply put pressure on him.）
Kageomi was about to give his order, when one member of the assassination squad suddenly began to cry out.
The trooper tried to look at Kageomi, but her face suddenly twisted to the side.
Her entire body was making odd, jerking movements.
That squad member was contorting her face in fear, and trying to stop her body, which moved on its own, but the force controlling her seemed to be surprisingly strong.
The soldier's hand trembled, and the gun she was holding pointed at Kageomi.
